lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows along the lateral flank, posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of higher luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, forming a localized grid pattern between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges along the mid-to-upper flank, exhibiting a light-to-shadow gradient transition from dorsal to ventral surfaces.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10-12 discrete high-luminance spots distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin.
